name: Agentic AI

days.lab_task: Classify six supplied business cases as rules-based automation, generative AI, retrieval-assisted generation, or agentic workflow. For each, identify input data, allowed actions, human approval point and a reason not to use a more autonomous approach.
days.deliverable: Six-case decision matrix and architecture sketch for one selected case
days.assessment:
Each case has one selected approach and evidence-based rationale
High-impact actions include an explicit approval or deny path
The proposed agent case names tools, boundaries and a failure escalation rather than claiming autonomy is always better
learning_objectives: Choose an approach based on task uncertainty and action risk
Identify when human approval is required
